title: Executive Assistant to Director
description:
I’m looking for someone who can help me operate better, think clearer and execute faster. I operate at a fast pace, think about multiple things simultaneously and enjoy exploring ideas that could turn into meaningful businesses. I value people who think independently, take ownership and get things done without needing to be micromanaged.

This is not a conventional Executive Assistant role. I need someone who can become an extension of me, understand how I work, anticipate my needs and bring structure to the many things I do.

What you will do

1. Manage my time and personal office

\* Own my calendar, meetings, appointments, reminders and daily schedule.

\* Help me prioritise what deserves my attention and protect my time for important decisions and strategic work.

\* Prepare a daily briefing so I know exactly what matters, what is pending and what needs my attention.

\* Plan and manage my domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, visas, itineraries and reservations.

\* Coordinate personal appointments, fitness schedules and other commitments.

\* Prepare meeting agendas, background notes and presentations before important meetings.

\* Record decisions, assign action items and follow up until they are completed.

\* Keep my important documents, contacts, bookings and records organised.

I want to spend less time remembering things, coordinating logistics and chasing people, and more time doing the things that actually move my businesses and life forward.

2. Be my execution partner

I have multiple ideas, projects and commitments running simultaneously. I need someone who can bring order to that complexity.

\* Convert my conversations, ideas and instructions into actionable tasks with clear owners and deadlines.

\* Maintain a master tracker of my projects, commitments and pending decisions.

\* Follow up with my teams, vendors, consultants and business partners to ensure things move forward.

\* Identify bottlenecks and delays before they become problems.

\* Solve routine problems independently and bring me solutions when a decision requires my involvement.

\* Ensure that important conversations don’t end without clear next steps.

\* Prepare a weekly update covering progress, pending actions, upcoming deadlines and potential issues.

\* Build systems that help me operate efficiently without having to personally oversee every detail.

I don’t want to keep asking people for updates. I want someone who knows what is happening, what is stuck and what needs to happen next.

3. Help me run and grow Geetham

Geetham is a growing restaurant business, and expansion brings a constant stream of projects, decisions and coordination.

\* Coordinate with my leadership team across operations, finance, HR, Legal, procurement and other functions.

\* Track new restaurant openings, expansion plans, operational projects and key business milestones.

\* Follow up on deliverables and commitments made by different teams.

\* Coordinate with landlords, consultants, vendors, investors and potential partners.

\* Help me prepare for business reviews and important meetings.

\* Research new opportunities in hospitality, accommodation, franchising and other adjacent businesses.

\* Maintain visibility into important projects without interfering with the day-to-day responsibilities of my operations team.

I need someone who understands that following up is not the same as micromanaging. The objective is to ensure that decisions are implemented and that I have visibility into what matters.

4. Work with me on new businesses and ideas

I’m entrepreneurial by nature, and I regularly explore opportunities beyond my existing businesses. Some ideas will become ventures; others will remain experiments.

I need someone comfortable navigating that uncertainty.

You may be involved in:

\* Developing and launching new brands and business concepts, including QSR and hospitality ventures.

\* Researching markets, competitors, business models and potential partners.

\* Coordinating designers, agencies, consultants and external collaborators.

\* Preparing business proposals, presentations, pitch decks and research briefs.

\* Supporting Sambar Cartel Studios with meetings, schedules, production coordination and external collaborations.

\* Working on special projects that may not fit neatly into any one business.

You don’t need to be an expert in every industry. You need to be resourceful enough to understand a new subject quickly, figure out what needs to happen and make it happen.

5. Research things and help me make better decisions

I frequently need to evaluate options, understand new markets, identify the right people to speak to or make decisions quickly.

I want you to:

\* Research businesses, people, products, services, locations and opportunities.

\* Compare alternatives on cost, quality, convenience, risks and potential value.

\* Prepare concise briefs with facts, options and your recommendation.

\* Draft emails, WhatsApp messages, meeting requests and professional correspondence on my behalf.

\* Maintain a database of important contacts, conversations and follow-ups.

\* Help prepare presentations, spreadsheets and business documents.

\* Use AI tools to accelerate research, planning, summarisation and repetitive tasks, while verifying important information.

I don’t need someone to send me 20 links and ask me to figure things out. I want someone to do the groundwork, filter the noise and tell me what they recommend and why.

6. Manage my travel and personal logistics

Travel is a significant part of my life, and I want it to be well planned without becoming another job for me.

\* Plan efficient travel itineraries based on my schedule, preferences and priorities.

\* Research flights, hotels, destinations, restaurants and experiences.

\* Manage bookings, transfers, visas and travel documentation.

\* Keep all confirmations and itineraries accessible in one place.

\* Coordinate my personal commitments alongside my business travel.

\* Help organise content shoots, events and other creative commitments when required.

I value thoughtful planning, attention to detail and the ability to anticipate problems before they occur.

7. Help me build a better operating system for my life

I want to work towards a system where my important commitments, projects, travel plans and follow-ups are organised and accessible rather than scattered across conversations, emails and notes.  
You will be expected to:

\* Build and maintain a reliable task and project management system.

\* Identify repetitive work that can be simplified, delegated or automated.

\* Keep my calendar, documents, contacts and project information organised.

\* Establish simple processes that reduce unnecessary communication and follow-ups.

\* Maintain strict confidentiality around my business, finances, relationships and personal life.

\* Exercise discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.

The goal is not to introduce complicated systems. It is to make my life simpler and my execution more consistent.

Who I am looking for

I care more about how you think and operate than the title on your previous job.

You will probably be a good fit if you:

\* Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.

\* Think two steps ahead and anticipate what I might need.

\* Are exceptionally organised without being rigid.

\* Can manage multiple projects without losing track of details.

\* Are comfortable communicating with senior executives, vendors, investors and external partners.

\* Have good commercial judgment and understand the value of time.

\* Can distinguish between something that needs my attention and something you can resolve yourself.

\* Write clearly, communicate confidently and follow up professionally.

\* Are curious about business and enjoy learning new things.

\* Can handle ambiguity, changing priorities and a fast-moving work environment.

\* Are discreet, trustworthy and emotionally mature.

\* Are comfortable using technology and AI tools to work smarter.

Experience and qualifications

\* Ideally, 3-7 years of experience in executive assistance, a founder’s office, business operations, project management, consulting or a similar role.

\* Previous experience working directly with a founder, entrepreneur or senior executive is a strong advantage.

\* Excellent written and spoken English; Communication in Tamil and Hindi are an advantage.

\* Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, spread sheets, presentations, calendars and project management tools.

\* Willingness to travel occasionally and accommodate a dynamic schedule when necessary.

I am open to candidates from different backgrounds if they demonstrate exceptional judgment, initiative and execution.

What I don’t want

I don’t want someone who:

\* Waits for me to provide instructions for every small task.

\* Forwards problems to me without exploring possible solutions.

\* Treats sending a message or making a phone call as the completion of a task.

\* Needs constant reminders to follow up.

\* Gets overwhelmed when priorities change.

\* Confuses being busy with being productive.

\* Shares confidential information or exercises poor judgment.

Ultimately, I want someone who makes me more effective, not someone who simply keeps me organised.

How to apply

Please share your CV along with a short note answering these questions:

1. Why do you think you’d be a great Executive Assistant to me?

2. Tell me about a time you independently managed a complicated project or solved a problem without being told exactly what to do.

3. What systems, tools or habits do you use to ensure that nothing falls through the cracks?

I am looking for someone who can bring structure to my ambition, clarity to my priorities and execution to my ideas.  
If you take ownership, think independently and enjoy making things happen, I’d like to hear from you.

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Workday Integration Consultant

These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* 8+ years of experience, including significant hands-on experience in Workday Integration development, support, and solution delivery.
* Deep expertise in Workday Integration technologies, including Workday Studio, EIB, Web Services APIs, Cloud Connectors, PECI, Report Writer, and Enterprise Interface design.
* Strong experience with Workday Business Process Framework, Configurable Security, Calculated Fields, and Workday reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting Workday Extend applications, workflows, integrations, and custom business solutions.
* Strong integration experience using XML, XSLT, Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions such as Informatica, and enterprise integration technologies.
* Experience supporting Workday HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA) integrations within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven experience leading integration projects, managing stakeholders, conducting workshops, troubleshooting critical production issues, and driving successful delivery outcomes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Knowledge and experience with Workday Orchestrate for workflow automation and integration orchestration.
* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

· Develop the overall recruitment strategy for each requirement and determine how the required manpower can be delivered within the stipulated timeline.

· Monitor recruitment progress and intervene at the appropriate level whenever there are delays, challenges or critical hiring requirements.

· Personally handle critical recruitment decisions, senior-level discussions and management coordination.

· Conduct discussions with shortlisted candidates on salary/CTC, expectations, employment terms and other critical aspects.

· Lead salary negotiation and contract/employment-term negotiation with selected candidates.

· Take appropriate decisions regarding candidate selection, compensation and offer closure within the approved framework.

· Ensure successful closure and joining of candidates within the committed timeline.

· Ensure manpower is made available for projects, O&M operations and other business requirements within the required deployment timeline.

· Manufacturing

· Production

· Assembly

· Process functions

· Design and Engineering

· Project Engineering

· O&M Engineering

· Technical functions

· Other manufacturing and engineering-related positions

The role will support recruitment requirements across South India and North India, including project and O&M locations.

· Oversee the overall **HR operations and payroll process**.

· Ensure payroll activities are carried out accurately and within the prescribed timelines.

· Ensure employee records, attendance, leave, payroll inputs and related HR processes are properly maintained.

· Monitor the HR team responsible for payroll and HR operations.

· Ensure HR operational processes are functioning effectively and consistently.

· Review and resolve critical HR operational issues in coordination with the concerned team members.

· Ensure that all applicable **statutory and labour-law requirements** are complied with.

· Ensure payroll and statutory activities are carried out as per applicable statutory norms and organizational requirements.

· Review the overall compliance status periodically.

· Ensure required records, documentation, filings and payments are maintained appropriately.

· Guide and monitor the HR team/executives handling day-to-day statutory activities.

· Coordinate with consultants or external agencies wherever required.

· Escalate any major compliance risks or deviations to management.

**4. TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT**

· Identify **training and development requirements** across departments.

· Discuss training requirements with HODs and management.

· Prepare an annual/monthly **training calendar**.

· Prepare and manage the **training budget**.

· Coordinate with internal mentors, subject-matter experts and external trainers.

· Plan and coordinate **monthly training programs**.

· Ensure appropriate technical, functional, behavioural and managerial development programs are conducted.

· Monitor employee participation and training effectiveness.

· Identify development requirements for individual employees and teams.

· Support continuous learning and employee capability development.

**5. PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT**

· Work closely with management and HODs to establish **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** for employees.

· Ensure KPIs are aligned with departmental and organizational objectives.

· Establish a structured performance measurement process.

· Review employee performance periodically with concerned HODs and management.

· Evaluate performance from both **technical and behavioural perspectives**.

· Identify performance gaps and development requirements.

· Support performance improvement plans wherever required.

· Coordinate the appraisal and performance review process.

· Ensure performance management is implemented consistently across the organization.

**6. HR POLICIES & EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT**

· Support management in developing and implementing effective **HR policies and procedures**.

· Review existing HR policies and recommend improvements wherever required.

· Ensure policies are communicated and implemented consistently.

· Develop employee engagement initiatives.

· Support employee motivation, recognition and retention initiatives.

· Maintain a positive and professional work environment.

· Act as an HR partner to HODs and management in resolving employee-related matters.

**7. TEAM MANAGEMENT & LEADERSHIP**

· Lead and manage the HR/recruitment team.

· Delegate recruitment and HR operational activities to appropriate team members.

· Set priorities and timelines for the HR team.

· Monitor the performance and productivity of HR executives and team members.

· Ensure recruitment activities are completed within agreed timelines.

· Mentor and develop junior HR team members.

· Provide guidance and support to the team in handling complex HR matters.

· Ensure clear accountability and ownership within the HR function.

description:
Are you a passionate and enthusiastic Dynamics 365 HR professional looking to build your career in HR digital transformation and enterprise application consulting?


Join LevelShift as a **Functional Consultant Dynamics 365 HR**, where you'll help organizations streamline and transform their HR processes by implementing and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources. You'll collaborate with HR stakeholders, business users, technical teams, and solution architects to understand existing HR processes, perform fit\-gap analysis, and deliver scalable HR solutions.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


As a **Functional Consultant Dynamics 365 HR** at LevelShift, you will:


* Engage with HR stakeholders and business users to understand existing HR processes, business requirements, and system challenges.
* Conduct requirement gathering, process analysis, and fit\-gap analysis to identify the best Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Analyze existing Workday or other HR systems and map their functionality and processes to Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Configure and implement Dynamics 365 HR functionalities based on business requirements and functional design.
* Prepare business requirement documents, functional design documents, process flows, user stories, and other functional documentation.
* Support HR system migration, including data mapping, data migration, validation, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations and the transition of functionality from legacy or third\-party HR applications.
* Work closely with HR stakeholders, business users, architects, and project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, end\-user training, deployment, and post\-implementation activities.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate existing HR applications, optimize business processes, and introduce automation using Dynamics 365 HR.
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**


* Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance consulting workflows, automate repetitive tasks, generate business insights, and improve productivity while ensuring solution quality and governance.
* Utilize AI\-assisted requirement analysis, process documentation, process mapping, testing, and workflow automation to improve project delivery efficiency.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Dynamics 365 Copilot, Power Platform Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric AI capabilities to support documentation, analysis, automation, testing, and HR process optimization.
* Explore opportunities to use AI capabilities to improve HR operations, automate routine processes, and provide actionable business insights.
  

  

**Your Skillset**


* 5\+ years of experience in functional consulting and solution delivery, with strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Strong hands\-on experience in configuring and implementing Dynamics 365 Human Resources functionalities based on business requirements.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, business process analysis, fit\-gap analysis, and functional solution design.
* Ability to work directly with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements and recommend appropriate Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Experience in preparing functional documentation, including BRD, FDD, process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
* Hands\-on experience with HR system migration, data mapping, data validation, and transitioning functionality from legacy or third\-party applications.
* Understanding of system integrations and collaboration with technical teams to support HR application integrations.
* Experience in SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, user training, and deployment activities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate with distributed teams, and drive activities from requirements through implementation.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI, and Microsoft ecosystem innovations.
  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


* Accelerate your career growth by working on impactful HR digital transformation and enterprise application initiatives.
* Gain hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources, Power Platform, AI, and modern business application technologies.
* Learn from experienced consultants, architects, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Work alongside cross\-functional teams that value innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Solve real\-world HR and business challenges by delivering scalable solutions that improve processes and operational efficiency.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, certification support, professional development programs, and exposure to emerging AI\-powered business applications.
